#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

# `warmup-session.sh` — bootstrapping a dev-environment session

Prepares a fresh machine (cloud dev-environment session, Codespace, throwaway VM/container)
so that this repo's `agents` submodule works out of the box — clones the product repo
(with the `agents` submodule) and pre-installs/pre-warms the toolchain used by
`setup/install.sh` (java, node, dmtools, copilot, gradle, android, konan, ...).

It does **not** run the agent pipeline itself. Secrets (`JIRA_EMAIL`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`,
`GH_TOKEN`/`PAT_TOKEN`, `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`, ...) must already be exposed as real
environment variables by whatever platform starts the session — `run-agent.sh` /
`run-teammate-local.sh` read those directly.

**Secret snapshot into `dmtools.env`**: the first time this script clones `--dir`
(not on later re-syncs of an already-cloned dir), it also snapshots whichever known
secret env vars are currently exported into `<dir>/dmtools.env` — the exact file
`run-agent.sh`/`run-teammate-local.sh` already load from. This exists because a
session template's env vars only live as long as the process/shell that started the
session; a cloud VM/container that later gets reconnected to or manually restarted
keeps its disk (repo + installed toolchain) but loses those env vars, so a fresh
ad-hoc shell would otherwise see `dmtools doctor` report every integration missing
and any `dmtools run ...`/SM invocation fail immediately with "Failed to create
TrackerClient instance" before the run even starts. The snapshot fixes that for any
later shell on the same disk. It never overwrites an existing `dmtools.env` (e.g. one
placed there by hand) and only writes vars matching a known secret-prefix pattern
(`JIRA_*`, `CONFLUENCE_*`, `FIGMA_*`, `GH_TOKEN`/`PAT_TOKEN`/`*GITHUB_TOKEN*`,
`GITLAB_*`, `BITBUCKET_*`, `ADO_*`, `RALLY_*`, `TESTRAIL_*`, `BITRISE_TOKEN`, `XRAY_*`,
`GEMINI_*`/`OPENAI_*`/`ANTHROPIC_*`/`BEDROCK_*`/`DIAL_*`/`OLLAMA_*`, `DEFAULT_TRACKER`,
`DEFAULT_LLM`) — if the session template exposes secrets under different names, add
them to `SECRET_VAR_PATTERN` in the script, or place a `dmtools.env` manually.

All examples below use a placeholder repo `your-org/your-product-repo` on branch `main`,
with the toolchain installed except `cursor`/`codemie`/`kimi`/`maestro`/`playwright`
(swap in whichever tools your project doesn't need — see `setup/install.sh` for the full
list). Replace with your actual repo, branch, and tool list.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for agent leg sessions.
#
# WHY (gh-918): machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no
# dart SDK on PATH ...
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [channel|version]    # stable|beta|dev | e.g. 3.9.4 (default: channel from the repo's quality workflow, else stable)
#   DART_VERSION=stable dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Subcommands (test surface — no network):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print key=value resolution without installing
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=... (empty when absent)
set -eu
```

```awk
/uses: *dart-lang\/setup-dart/ {inblock=1; next}
inblock && /- name:|uses:/ {inblock=0}
inblock && /channel:/ {gsub(/.*channel:[ ]*/, ""); gsub(/["'#]/, ""); gsub(/[ ]*#.*/, ""); print "channel=" $1; inblock=0}
inblock && /sdk:/ {gsub(/.*sdk:[ ]*/, ""); gsub(/["'#]/, ""); gsub(/[ ]*#.*/, ""); print "sdk=" $1; inblock=0}
```

3. else if quality.yml `channel:` → channel mode.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#

# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]

#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1

# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF

}

# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default

resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then

  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then

# `warmup-session.sh` — bootstrapping a dev-environment session

Prepares a fresh machine (cloud dev-environment session, Codespace, throwaway VM/container)
so that this repo's `agents` submodule works out of the box — clones the product repo
(with the `agents` submodule) and pre-installs/pre-warms the toolchain used by
`setup/install.sh` (java, node, dmtools, copilot, gradle, android, konan, ...).

It does **not** run the agent pipeline itself. Secrets (`JIRA_EMAIL`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`,
`GH_TOKEN`/`PAT_TOKEN`, `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`, ...) must already be exposed as real
environment variables by whatever platform starts the session — `run-agent.sh` /
`run-teammate-local.sh` read those directly.

**Secret snapshot into `dmtools.env`**: the first time this script clones `--dir`
(not on later re-syncs of an already-cloned dir), it also snapshots whichever known
secret env vars are currently exported into `<dir>/dmtools.env` — the exact file
`run-agent.sh`/`run-teammate-local.sh` already load from. This exists because a
session template's env vars only live as long as the process/shell that started the
session; a cloud VM/container that later gets reconnected to or manually restarted
keeps its disk (repo + installed toolchain) but loses those env vars, so a fresh
ad-hoc shell would otherwise see `dmtools doctor` report every integration missing
and any `dmtools run ...`/SM invocation fail immediately with "Failed to create
TrackerClient instance" before the run even starts. The snapshot fixes that for any
later shell on the same disk. It never overwrites an existing `dmtools.env` (e.g. one
placed there by hand) and only writes vars matching a known secret-prefix pattern
(`JIRA_*`, `CONFLUENCE_*`, `FIGMA_*`, `GH_TOKEN`/`PAT_TOKEN`/`*GITHUB_TOKEN*`,
`GITLAB_*`, `BITBUCKET_*`, `ADO_*`, `RALLY_*`, `TESTRAIL_*`, `BITRISE_TOKEN`, `XRAY_*`,
`GEMINI_*`/`OPENAI_*`/`ANTHROPIC_*`/`BEDROCK_*`/`DIAL_*`/`OLLAMA_*`, `DEFAULT_TRACKER`,
`DEFAULT_LLM`) — if the session template exposes secrets under different names, add
them to `SECRET_VAR_PATTERN` in the script, or place a `dmtools.env` manually.

All examples below use a placeholder repo `your-org/your-product-repo` on branch `main`,
with the toolchain installed except `cursor`/`codemie`/`kimi`/`maestro`/`playwright`
(swap in whichever tools your project doesn't need — see `setup/install.sh` for the full
list). Replace with your actual repo, branch, and tool list.

## Running SM afterwards — keep run logs outside the repo

Once the session is warmed up, use `run-sm-local.sh` to start the SM agent
(`sm.json`, `forceLocalTeammate:true`) instead of invoking `dmtools run` by hand:

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

**Previous attempt**: None — first development pass on gh-918.

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).

#

#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)

#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"

    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"

  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue

        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block

        *channel:*)

    done < "${f}"
  done

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

**Previous attempt**: None — first development pass on gh-918.

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).

#

#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)

#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"

    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"

  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue

        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block

        *channel:*)

    done < "${f}"
  done

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

Design of `setup/dart.sh`:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for agent leg sessions.
#
# WHY (gh-918): machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no
# dart SDK on PATH ...
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [channel|version]    # stable|beta|dev | e.g. 3.9.4 (default: channel from the repo's quality workflow, else stable)
#   DART_VERSION=stable dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Subcommands (test surface — no network):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print key=value resolution without installing
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=... (empty when absent)
set -eu
```

Key functions:
- `detect_os_arch()` → os=linux|macos, arch=x64|arm64.
- `quality_channel_and_sdk()` → scans .github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml} for `uses: dart-lang/setup-dart`, then within the following lines (up to next `uses:`/`- name:`/dedent...) find `channel:` and `sdk:`. Simple awk implementation:

```awk
/uses: *dart-lang\/setup-dart/ {inblock=1; next}
inblock && /- name:|uses:/ {inblock=0}
inblock && /channel:/ {gsub(/.*channel:[ ]*/, ""); gsub(/["'#]/, ""); gsub(/[ ]*#.*/, ""); print "channel=" $1; inblock=0}
inblock && /sdk:/ {gsub(/.*sdk:[ ]*/, ""); gsub(/["'#]/, ""); gsub(/[ ]*#.*/, ""); print "sdk=" $1; inblock=0}
```

Hmm, careful with `sdk:` — setup-dart's param is `sdk:` (e.g. `sdk: 3.5.0` or `sdk: dev`). And `channel:` (stable/beta/dev). Both under `with:`. The block ends at next `- name:`/`uses:` line. Keep scanning even after finding one of them (a file may specify both) — actually keep inblock until a terminator line; collect both channel and sdk.

Then resolution precedence:
1. explicit arg / DART_VERSION env → target. If target ∈ {stable, beta, dev} → channel mode (or `latest` → stable).
2. else if quality.yml `sdk:` → version mode (channel = quality `channel:` or stable).
3. else if quality.yml `channel:` → channel mode.
4. else → stable.

- `resolve_version()` — for channel mode, fetch `<base>/channels/<channel>/release/latest/VERSION`, parse `"version": "x.y.z"`. Network; fallback "".
- `installed_version()` — `dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p'`. (Actual banner: `Dart SDK version: 3.13.5 (stable) on "linux_x64"...`.)

- plan output (key=value, eval-safe-ish):
```
os=linux
arch=x64
requested=stable        # what the caller asked (arg|env|detection)
mode=channel|version
channel=stable
version=3.13.5|latest|3.9.4
install_dir=/root/.dart-sdk
sdk_home=/root/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk
sdk_bin_dir=.../bin
sdk_url=https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive/channels/stable/release/latest/sdk/dartsdk-linux-x64-release.zip
source=quality.yml|default|argument
```
For plan mode, version resolution: try resolve; if network fails, version=latest (the URL stays `release/latest`). Hmm — URL for version mode: `release/<version>`; for channel mode plan: `release/latest` (install resolves then rewrites URL). For hermetic tests, plan must not require network → in plan mode, SKIP resolution and print `version=latest` for channel mode? But then test can't assert a concrete version... Tests will assert: mode, channel, install dir, URL shape (contains `channels/beta/release/latest/sdk/dartsdk-linux-x64-release.zip`), source. That's the decision logic. Version resolution correctness is trivial sed. OK: plan = no network. Document it.

- install flow:
```
1. resolve target (arg/env/detection) → mode+channel|version
2. version resolution for channel mode → concrete (network; on failure with installed dart → degrade+warn+exit 0 after register; on failure without dart → continue with release/latest URL (best effort) — actually keep simpler: if resolution fails, use release/latest URL and version=latest)
3. if installed_version == resolved version → cache hit: register_path bin, export DART_HOME/DART_SDK_HOME?/DART_VERSION, exit 0
   - version resolution failed but dart installed → cache hit (unverified) + warning
4. else download+unzip to install_dir, register_path, export, verify dart --version
```

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

**Previous attempt**: None — first development pass on gh-918.
"}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done
  echo "${sdk}|${channel}"
}
```

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

  echo "🎯 Dart SDK [target=${TARGET:-<detect>} mode=${MODE} channel=${CHANNEL} os=${OS} arch=${ARCH} ci=$(detect_ci)]"

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

**Previous attempt**: None — first development pass on gh-918.
"}

# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#

# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#

#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)

source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi

    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1

# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {

    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1

# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {

    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue

  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }

EOF

#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

**Previous attempt**: None — first development pass on gh-918.

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)

source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1

# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then

  fi

  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"

  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
