{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-918

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then

  fi

    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)

      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"

sdk_url() {

}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"

    exit 1

}

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#

# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#

#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]

#   dart.sh status

DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac

    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"

channel_latest() {

    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue

$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }

    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0

EOF

#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment, so they cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check` — they can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claim success while violations remain in place.

**Root cause**: The agents repo's factory setup layer — `setup/` — has no Dart SDK provisioner. `setup/install.sh` (`ALL_TOOLS` = java maven node dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi fa gradle android emulator konan) and `setup/cache.sh` cover every other toolchain the legs use, but nothing installs a cached `dart`; the leg-session extension point (`customParams.setupCommands` → `js/common/setupCommands.js`, consumed by `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` / `preCliReworkSetup.js`) therefore has no dart command to call. `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` even asserts "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" — false on the hosted runner images the factory legs use, which ship no Dart SDK at all.

**Impact**: Dart-repo factories (epam/dmtools-dart) rework legs cannot reproduce the CI gate output locally. Evidence from the ticket: #408 (CRAP 9.00) needed an operator fix, #413 rework legs (08:56Z/09:22Z) reported success but left method_size violations in place, #414 needed an operator refactor (UpgradeCommand.run CC=12, 94-line test main). Every gate violation on a dart repo burns a rework round before an operator intervenes.

**Fix approach**: Add a cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner following the exact existing installer pattern (the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs — cached per version, exposed on PATH for the leg session):

- `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]` — resolves the target the same way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/env (`DART_VERSION`) first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/quality*.yml` (its `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs — "same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), falling back to `stable`. Installs the SDK from the dart-archive CDN that `dart-lang/setup-dart` itself downloads from, under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, and puts its `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`register_path` — works for the current shell AND subsequent CI steps via `GITHUB_PATH`/envman) plus `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION` exports. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch, so pool VMs with persistent `$HOME` never shadow the requested toolchain.
- Wire it into `setup/install.sh` (tool list + PATH verification) and `setup/cache.sh` (`DART_CACHE_*` key/path for `actions/cache`-style restore/save) so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- Correct the false "dart from the runner image" claim in `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` and document the `DART_VERSION` var; document the tool in `README.md`.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done
  echo "${sdk}|${channel}"
}
```

# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done
  echo "${sdk}|${channel}"
}
```

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

  echo "🎯 Dart SDK [target=${TARGET:-<detect>} mode=${MODE} channel=${CHANNEL} os=${OS} arch=${ARCH} ci=$(detect_ci)]"

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done
  echo "${sdk}|${channel}"
}
```

The next step starts with `- uses:` or `- name:` or `- run:`. My terminator patterns: `*- name:*`, `*uses:*` (careful — the setup-dart line itself matched first and `continue`s, so no double-processing), `*- run:*`. Note `*- run:*` — a with value can't contain "- run:". OK.

But careful: `case "${line}" in *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*)` — the `uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1` line. And terminator `*uses:*` would end block when the NEXT `uses:` line arrives — but since setup-dart line continues (skips terminators), fine. Order of case matters: check the setup-dart match FIRST (it has *uses:* too).

quality_detection() {
  local dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  [ -d "${dir}/.github/workflows" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  awk '
    /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ {inb=1; next}

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's

#

#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh

SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;

    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;

}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {

    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"

    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue

$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }

    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0

EOF

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).

# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {

  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1

  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

extract_zip() {

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac

    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac

}

# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done
  echo "${sdk}|${channel}"
}

The next step starts with `- uses:` or `- name:` or `- run:`. My terminator patterns: `*- name:*`, `*uses:*` (careful — the setup-dart line itself matched first and `continue`s, so no double-processing), `*- run:*`. Note `*- run:*` — a with value can't contain "- run:". OK.

But careful: `case "${line}" in *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*)` — the `uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1` line. And terminator `*uses:*` would end block when the NEXT `uses:` line arrives — but since setup-dart line continues (skips terminators), fine. Order of case matters: check the setup-dart match FIRST (it has *uses:* too).

# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's

#

#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh

SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;

    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;

}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {

    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"

    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue

$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }

    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0

EOF

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block
        *sdk:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*sdk:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"
          ;;
        *channel:*)
          v="$(printf '%s\n' "${line}" | sed 's/^.*channel:[[:space:]]*//; s/["'"']//g; s/[[:space:]]*#.*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"
          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done
  echo "${sdk}|${channel}"
}
```
