{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""

      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).

# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...

#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac

    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {

  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).

  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"

    inblock=0

      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had NO dart SDK on PATH —
# they could not run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check`, so they
# could neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size /
# format) and claimed success while violations stayed in place. Same pattern
# as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: the SDK is cached per
# resolved version and exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses — the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `channel:`/`sdk:`
# inputs in `.github/workflows/*.yml`. The SDK itself downloads from the same
# dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, so leg-local gate output
# matches CI gate output.
#
# Version-aware like setup/fa.sh: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on
# mismatch — pool VMs keep a PERSISTENT $HOME, so a presence-only check lets
# an ancient binary shadow the requested toolchain forever.
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]  # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh         # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface — js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [stable|beta|dev|<version>]
#       print the resolved target/URL/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status
#       print installed=<version from the dart --version banner> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"
DART_INSTALL_DIR="${DART_INSTALL_DIR:-${HOME}/.dart-sdk}"
SDK_HOME="${DART_INSTALL_DIR}/dart-sdk"
SDK_BIN="${SDK_HOME}/bin"

# ── Platform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks PATH first, then
# our own install dir — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin dir
# is registered on PATH.
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  elif [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# Latest concrete version of a channel (dart-lang/setup-dart resolves "latest"
# through the same VERSION file).
channel_latest() {
  curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/$1/release/latest/VERSION" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1
}

# ── Quality-workflow detection ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") ──
# Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step and
# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {
  local f kv found=0 sdk="" channel=""
  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r kv; do
      case "${kv}" in
        step=*)    found=1 ;;
        sdk=*)     if [ -n "${kv#sdk=}" ] && [ -z "${sdk}" ]; then sdk="${kv#sdk=}"; found=1; fi ;;
        channel=*) if [ -n "${kv#channel=}" ] && [ -z "${channel}" ]; then channel="${kv#channel=}"; found=1; fi ;;
      esac
    done <<EOF
$(awk -v sq="'" '
  /uses:[[:space:]]*dart-lang\/setup-dart/ { inb = 1; print "step=1"; next }
  inb && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*(name|uses|run):[[:space:]]/ { inb = 0 }
  inb && /sdk:/ {
    sub(/.*sdk:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "sdk=" $0
  }
  inb && /channel:/ {
    sub(/.*channel:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/["]/, ""); gsub(sq, "")
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, ""); gsub(/[[:space:]]/, ""); print "channel=" $0
  }
' "${f}" 2>/dev/null)
EOF
  done
  echo "${found}|${sdk}|${channel}"
}

# ── Target resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Precedence (sets TARGET/MODE/CHANNEL/VERSION/SOURCE):
#   1. explicit argument           → source=argument
#   2. DART_VERSION env            → source=environment
#   3. quality.yml sdk:/channel:   → source=quality workflow
#   4. stable                      → source=default
# A pinned version rides the DETECTED channel (setup-dart keeps using the
# channel for a full version), so leg output keeps matching CI exactly.
resolve_target() {
  local arg="${1:-}"
  TARGET="${arg:-${DART_VERSION:-}}"
  SOURCE="default"
  if [ -n "${arg}" ]; then
    SOURCE="argument"
  elif [ -n "${DART_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    SOURCE="environment"
  fi

  local det found det_sdk det_channel
  det="$(quality_detection)"
  found="${det%%|*}"; det="${det#*|}"
  det_sdk="${det%%|*}"; det_channel="${det#*|}"

  if [ -z "${TARGET}" ] && [ "${found}" = "1" ]; then
    SOURCE="quality workflow"
  fi

  case "${TARGET}" in
    ""|latest|stable|beta|dev)
      MODE="channel"
      CHANNEL="${TARGET}"
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] || [ "${CHANNEL}" = "latest" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_channel}"; fi
      if [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ]; then CHANNEL="${det_sdk:+stable}"; fi
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      VERSION=""
      ;;
    *)
      MODE="version"
      VERSION="${TARGET}"
      CHANNEL="${det_channel}"
      [ -z "${CHANNEL}" ] && CHANNEL="stable"
      case "${CHANNEL}" in stable|beta|dev) ;; *) CHANNEL="stable" ;; esac
      ;;
  esac
}

# dart-archive release URL. Channel mode resolves to `latest` until the
# concrete version is fetched at install time.
sdk_url() {
  local ver="${1:-${VERSION:-latest}}"
  [ -n "${ver}" ] || ver="latest"
  echo "${DART_ARCHIVE}/channels/${CHANNEL}/release/${ver}/sdk/dartsdk-${OS}-${ARCH}-release.zip"
}

print_plan() {
  if [ "${MODE}" = "version" ]; then
    echo "requested=${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "requested=${CHANNEL}"
  fi
  echo "mode=${MODE}"
  echo "channel=${CHANNEL}"
  echo "version=${VERSION:-latest}"
  echo "source=${SOURCE}"
  echo "install_dir=${DART_INSTALL_DIR}"
  echo "sdk_home=${SDK_HOME}"
  echo "sdk_bin_dir=${SDK_BIN}"
  echo "sdk_url=$(sdk_url)"
  echo "register_path=${SDK_BIN}"
}

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_zip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -q "$1" -d "$2"
  elif [ "$(detect_os)" = "macos" ] && command -v ditto >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ditto -x -k "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "❌ neither unzip nor ditto available to extract $1" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

export_dart_env() {
  export_var "DART_HOME" "${SDK_HOME}"
  export_var "DART_VERSION" "$1"
}

do_install() {
  echo "🎯 Dart SDK [target=${TARGET:-<detect>} mode=${MODE} channel=${CHANNEL} os=${OS} arch=${ARCH} ci=$(detect_ci)]"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the Dart SDK — cached, channel-aware provisioner for machine-factory
# leg sessions (gh-918).
#
# WHY: the factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos had no dart SDK ...
# Same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs: cached per
# resolved version, exposed on PATH for the leg session, resolving the SAME
# channel (and pinned version, when CI pins one) the checked-out repo's
# quality workflow uses (the dart-lang/setup-dart step).
#
# Usage:
#   dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]   # default: dart-lang/setup-dart detection in .github/workflows/*.yml, else stable
#   DART_VERSION=beta dart.sh
#   DART_INSTALL_DIR=... dart.sh          # default: ~/.dart-sdk (SDK lands at <dir>/dart-sdk)
#
# Network-free subcommands (unit-test surface, js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js):
#   dart.sh plan [target]   # print the resolved target/url/layout as key=value — no download
#   dart.sh status          # print installed=<dart --version banner version> ('' when absent)
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/_common.sh"

DART_ARCHIVE="https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive"

os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    arm64|aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported arch ($(uname -m))" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}

installed_version() {
  command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ""; return 0; }
  dart --version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

quality_detection() {
  # Scan the checked-out repo's workflows for the dart-lang/setup-dart step;
  # echo "<sdk>|<channel>" (either may be empty).
  local dir files f
  dir="${DART_QUALITY_SCAN_DIR:-$PWD}"
  files=""
  if command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    files="$(find "${dir}/.github/workflows" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null)"
  fi
  [ -n "${files}" ] || { echo "|"; return 0; }
  local sdk="" channel="" line inblock=0
  for f in ${files}; do
    inblock=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      case "${line}" in
        *uses:*dart-lang/setup-dart*) inblock=1; continue ;;
      esac
      [ "${inblock}" = "1" ] || continue
      case "${line}" in
        *- name:*|*uses:*|*- run:*|'    '*-*) inblock=0; continue ;;   # hmm, next step ends the with-block

          [ -n "${v}" ] && sdk="${v}"

          [ -n "${v}" ] && channel="${v}"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "${f}"
  done

}

# dart-archive bundle naming: dartsdk-<os>-<arch>-release.zip (x64/arm64).
os_arch() {
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    Darwin) OS="macos" ;;
    Linux)  OS="linux" ;;
    *) echo "❌ unsupported OS ($(uname -s)) for the dart-archive SDK bundle" >&2; exit 1 ;;

    x86_64)        ARCH="x64" ;;

}

# read its with: inputs. Echoes "found|sdk|channel" (any field may be empty).
quality_detection() {

  for f in "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yml "${PWD}"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

> **dmtools runtimes:** the default `install.sh all` / `install.sh dmtools`
> installs the **Java DMTools CLI** (epam/dm.ai) — it stays the primary
> orchestrator. The **Dart port** (epam/dmtools-dart) is opt-in only:
> `install.sh dmtools-dart` or `setup/dmtools-dart.sh`. It installs
> side-by-side under `~/.dmtools-dart/bin` (both ship a `dmtools` binary —
> PATH order decides which wins when both are on PATH) and is never pulled
> in by `install.sh all`.


`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /

registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

> **dmtools runtimes:** the default `install.sh all` / `install.sh dmtools`
> installs the **Java DMTools CLI** (epam/dm.ai) — it stays the primary
> orchestrator. The **Dart port** (epam/dmtools-dart) is opt-in only:
> `install.sh dmtools-dart` or `setup/dmtools-dart.sh`. It installs
> side-by-side under `~/.dmtools-dart/bin` (both ship a `dmtools` binary —
> PATH order decides which wins when both are on PATH) and is never pulled
> in by `install.sh all`.


`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

{"newText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

Because `printf '#!/bin/sh\necho %s\n' 'DART...'` — the %s inserts the content verbatim → `echo Dart SDK version: 3.5.4 (stable) on "linux_x64"` — the shq quotes are consumed by the OUTER shell as argument quoting, NOT part of the inserted text. So the generated stub has an unquoted echo → running it: sh syntax error on `(stable)` → no banner → installed empty.

Fix the stub generation to EMBED quotes in the script text: make the printf format produce `echo 'BANNER'` — i.e., pass format `#!/bin/sh\necho '%s'\n`? Then %s inside single quotes in the FORMAT — printf doesn't interpret quotes; format is `#!/bin/sh\necho '%s'\n` → output `echo 'Dart SDK version...'`. In JS:

```js
lines.push("printf '#!/bin/sh\\necho '\\''%s'\\''\\n' " + dsShq(opts.stubDart) + ' > "$d/bin/dart"');

lines.push('printf %s ' + dsShq('#!/bin/sh\necho ' + dsShq(opts.stubDart)) + ' > "$d/bin/dart"');

The full script text: `#!/bin/sh\necho 'Dart SDK...'` — single-quoted inside the file → sh echoes banner verbatim. Then the outer dsShq wraps THAT (contains single quotes → escaped `'\''`). Works.

— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

Root cause: I installed the real Dart SDK at `~/.dart-sdk` earlier for verification, and `installed_version()` falls back to `${SDK_BIN}/dart` even when dart is NOT on PATH. The test's sandbox has no `dart` on PATH (stub absent), but the script finds `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk/bin/dart` — by design! (that fallback is deliberate: a cache-restored SDK is real even before PATH registration).

> PATH order decides which wins when both are on PATH) and is never pulled
> in by `install.sh all`.


`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. {"content":"### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. Downloads from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, registers `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`GITHUB_PATH`/envman) and exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: wired `dart` into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- `docs/machine-factory-integration.md`: corrected the false "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" claim; documented the `DART_VERSION` var and the `customParams.setupCommands` wiring (`bash agents/setup/dart.sh`) for dart-repo runners.
- `README.md` / `scripts/warmup-session.md`: tool documentation.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 tests — resolution precedence (argument > env > quality.yml `sdk:`/`channel:` > stable), dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, installed-version banner parsing, and the `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. Hermetic mktemp sandboxes (`DART_INSTALL_DIR` isolated from the host), self-skip when bash is unavailable — same pattern as `test_reviewVerdict.js`. RED first (12 failing on the pre-fix tree), then GREEN.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live end-to-end on the runner: `bash setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5 from the dart-archive CDN; second run hit the version-aware cache; `bash setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Dart-repo runners opt in per repo via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (or ride `install.sh all`); non-dart repos are unaffected. `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache.
- The leg's gate output now matches CI byte-for-byte channel-wise: a `sdk:` pin rides the quality workflow's own `channel:` for the download URL, exactly as `dart-lang/setup-dart` resolves it.
- No changes to dispatch/workflow configs — the factory teammate workflow stays frozen; the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

{"content":"### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. Downloads from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, registers `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`GITHUB_PATH`/envman) and exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: wired `dart` into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- `docs/machine-factory-integration.md`: corrected the false "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" claim; documented the `DART_VERSION` var and the `customParams.setupCommands` wiring (`bash agents/setup/dart.sh`) for dart-repo runners.
- `README.md` / `scripts/warmup-session.md`: tool documentation.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 tests — resolution precedence (argument > env > quality.yml `sdk:`/`channel:` > stable), dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, installed-version banner parsing, and the `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. Hermetic mktemp sandboxes (`DART_INSTALL_DIR` isolated from the host), self-skip when bash is unavailable — same pattern as `test_reviewVerdict.js`. RED first (12 failing on the pre-fix tree), then GREEN.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live end-to-end on the runner: `bash setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5 from the dart-archive CDN; second run hit the version-aware cache; `bash setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Dart-repo runners opt in per repo via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (or ride `install.sh all`); non-dart repos are unaffected. `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache.
- The leg's gate output now matches CI byte-for-byte channel-wise: a `sdk:` pin rides the quality workflow's own `channel:` for the download URL, exactly as `dart-lang/setup-dart` resolves it.
- No changes to dispatch/workflow configs — the factory teammate workflow stays frozen; the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:

{"content":"### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. Downloads from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, registers `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`GITHUB_PATH`/envman) and exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: wired `dart` into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- `docs/machine-factory-integration.md`: corrected the false "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" claim; documented the `DART_VERSION` var and the `customParams.setupCommands` wiring (`bash agents/setup/dart.sh`) for dart-repo runners.
- `README.md` / `scripts/warmup-session.md`: tool documentation.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 tests — resolution precedence (argument > env > quality.yml `sdk:`/`channel:` > stable), dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, installed-version banner parsing, and the `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. Hermetic mktemp sandboxes (`DART_INSTALL_DIR` isolated from the host), self-skip when bash is unavailable — same pattern as `test_reviewVerdict.js`. RED first (12 failing on the pre-fix tree), then GREEN.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live end-to-end on the runner: `bash setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5 from the dart-archive CDN; second run hit the version-aware cache; `bash setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Dart-repo runners opt in per repo via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (or ride `install.sh all`); non-dart repos are unaffected. `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache.
- The leg's gate output now matches CI byte-for-byte channel-wise: a `sdk:` pin rides the quality workflow's own `channel:` for the download URL, exactly as `dart-lang/setup-dart` resolves it.
- No changes to dispatch/workflow configs — the factory teammate workflow stays frozen; the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of

{"content":"### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. Downloads from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, registers `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`GITHUB_PATH`/envman) and exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: wired `dart` into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- `docs/machine-factory-integration.md`: corrected the false "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" claim; documented the `DART_VERSION` var and the `customParams.setupCommands` wiring (`bash agents/setup/dart.sh`) for dart-repo runners.
- `README.md` / `scripts/warmup-session.md`: tool documentation.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 tests — resolution precedence (argument > env > quality.yml `sdk:`/`channel:` > stable), dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, installed-version banner parsing, and the `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. Hermetic mktemp sandboxes (`DART_INSTALL_DIR` isolated from the host), self-skip when bash is unavailable — same pattern as `test_reviewVerdict.js`. RED first (12 failing on the pre-fix tree), then GREEN.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live end-to-end on the runner: `bash setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5 from the dart-archive CDN; second run hit the version-aware cache; `bash setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Dart-repo runners opt in per repo via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (or ride `install.sh all`); non-dart repos are unaffected. `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache.
- The leg's gate output now matches CI byte-for-byte channel-wise: a `sdk:` pin rides the quality workflow's own `channel:` for the download URL, exactly as `dart-lang/setup-dart` resolves it.
- No changes to dispatch/workflow configs — the factory teammate workflow stays frozen; the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel

- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. Downloads from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, registers `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`GITHUB_PATH`/envman) and exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: wired `dart` into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- `docs/machine-factory-integration.md`: corrected the false "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" claim; documented the `DART_VERSION` var and the `customParams.setupCommands` wiring (`bash agents/setup/dart.sh`) for dart-repo runners.
- `README.md` / `scripts/warmup-session.md`: tool documentation.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 tests — resolution precedence (argument > env > quality.yml `sdk:`/`channel:` > stable), dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, installed-version banner parsing, and the `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. Hermetic mktemp sandboxes (`DART_INSTALL_DIR` isolated from the host), self-skip when bash is unavailable — same pattern as `test_reviewVerdict.js`. RED first (12 failing on the pre-fix tree), then GREEN.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live end-to-end on the runner: `bash setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5 from the dart-archive CDN; second run hit the version-aware cache; `bash setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Dart-repo runners opt in per repo via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (or ride `install.sh all`); non-dart repos are unaffected. `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache.
- The leg's gate output now matches CI byte-for-byte channel-wise: a `sdk:` pin rides the quality workflow's own `channel:` for the download URL, exactly as `dart-lang/setup-dart` resolves it.
- No changes to dispatch/workflow configs — the factory teammate workflow stays frozen; the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Machine-factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK in the leg environment — hosted runner images ship no `dart`, and the agents repo's factory setup layer (`setup/`) had no Dart provisioner to close the gap. A rework leg therefore cannot run `dart analyze` / `dart test` / `dart format` / `crap4dart check`: it can neither see nor verify quality-gate violations (CRAP / method_size / format) and claims success while violations stay in place (gh-918 evidence: #408 operator-fixed, #413 "success" with method_size violations left in place, #414 operator refactor).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — the same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target the way the repo's CI does: explicit argument/`DART_VERSION` env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` inputs in the checked-out repo's quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`. Downloads from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart` uses, installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`, registers `bin` on PATH for the leg session (`GITHUB_PATH`/envman) and exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`. Version-aware like `setup/fa.sh`: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: wired `dart` into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path so CI can cache the SDK per version.
- `docs/machine-factory-integration.md`: corrected the false "pure-Dart targets get `dart` from the runner image" claim; documented the `DART_VERSION` var and the `customParams.setupCommands` wiring (`bash agents/setup/dart.sh`) for dart-repo runners.
- `README.md` / `scripts/warmup-session.md`: tool documentation.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 tests — resolution precedence (argument > env > quality.yml `sdk:`/`channel:` > stable), dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, installed-version banner parsing, and the `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. Hermetic mktemp sandboxes (`DART_INSTALL_DIR` isolated from the host), self-skip when bash is unavailable — same pattern as `test_reviewVerdict.js`. RED first (12 failing on the pre-fix tree), then GREEN.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live end-to-end on the runner: `bash setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5 from the dart-archive CDN; second run hit the version-aware cache; `bash setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Dart-repo runners opt in per repo via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (or ride `install.sh all`); non-dart repos are unaffected. `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache.
- The leg's gate output now matches CI byte-for-byte channel-wise: a `sdk:` pin rides the quality workflow's own `channel:` for the download URL, exactly as `dart-lang/setup-dart` resolves it.
- No changes to dispatch/workflow configs — the factory teammate workflow stays frozen; the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
[IstiN/flutter_agent_harness](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases)
— the platform bundle (`fa-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz`: `bin/fa` + `lib/`, same
layout `install_local.sh` produces) lands in `~/.local/bin` + `~/.local/lib`
(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is
registered on PATH for subsequent CI steps.

(override with `FA_INSTALL_DIR`), pin a release with `fa.sh v0.1.324` /
`FA_VERSION`. Fallback: the fa1.dev upstream installer. The bin dir is

### Dart SDK (agent legs on Dart repos)

`setup/install.sh dart` (or `setup/dart.sh [stable|beta|dev|<version>]`,
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`;
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses, so leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME` / `DART_VERSION`;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it per resolved version with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`).
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).","oldText":"`setup/install.sh fa` installs from the GitHub Releases of
